# Topic 10 cover v01

Built-in image_gen prompt, used verbatim:

```text
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: landscape 3:2 ecology website cover illustration with genuine transparent exterior.

Primary request: Paint one contiguous lake-environment vignette in a detailed natural-history watercolor and gouache style. The lake habitat is the main subject and occupies almost all of the environmental patch. This is an illustrative environment, not a real monitoring site, a forecast map, a safety assessment, or evidence that a bloom will occur.

Scene: A quiet freshwater lake margin with irregular reeds, grasses, low bank vegetation, stones and shallow water merging into a broad connected water area. The water has restrained blue-grey and sage-green tones, with very fine, subtle green cyanobacterial tint or flecks. Keep it natural and gentle, never fluorescent or an exaggerated poisonous pea-soup pool. Include exactly one tiny ordinary floating monitoring buoy near a margin, modest and secondary to the habitat. A thin cable descends naturally from the buoy, with a small probe subtly visible below the water surface in a clear shallow-water area. Keep the hardware tiny, approximately two or three percent of the patch width, with plausible waterline and underwater placement.

Style: Fine botanical detail, visible delicate watercolor washes and opaque gouache accents, rich but quiet natural textures, muted moss/sage/ochre/blue-grey colors. Match the visual vocabulary of a finely detailed natural-history forest vignette: layered foliage, believable natural forms, organic ground edges and a unified atmosphere. Painterly rather than photographic, playful cartoon, CGI or a plastic 3D render.

Composition: A single connected unframed environment patch on a 3:2 landscape canvas, slightly elevated natural viewpoint, with coherent shoreline depth. Use an irregular organic silhouette and small fully transparent margins on every side. Vegetation and water edges taper into genuine alpha transparency. No rectangular water tile, geometric island base, cutaway slab, border, paper rectangle, white background or backdrop halo.

Text: None.
Avoid: All writing, labels, numbers, symbols, arrows, UI, charts, maps, prediction heatmaps, warning colors, brand marks, enormous instruments, laboratory equipment, isolated object collages, guns, traps, dead animals or dramatic pollution.
Output: One PNG with true transparency outside the painted environmental vignette; preserve fine natural edge detail.
```
